text: I came in today for a consultation and received such good advice and care :) The space is very clean and comfortable. I got acupuncture and cupping done & all of it felt amazing! I will be going back routinely 😍 …

I've been suffering from awful neck pain so visited this clinic for some TCM, it's just opposite Macro which wa handy for parking.

I had a warm welcome, it appeared very clean and my practitioner Claire was excellent, friendly, helpful and clearly very experienced. The consultation process was clear and took about ten minutes.

I then received a combination of treatments (I won't confess to know the names of them all), including some kind of muscle rub, cupping, acupuncture and heat treatment.

I left feeling much better and so far the absolutely terrible neck pain I have been experiencing has been eliviated which feels like some kind of miracle considering I've already had two rounds of physio without much change.

I would highly recommend Claire!

How is it that we can find things when we're not even searching for them? I quite literally passed by the Piraluna Clinic one afternoon by pure chance. One quick message, followed by a prompt response confirmed my appointment for my TCM consultation.

As they say, there's a first time for everything and this was certainly an excellent place to start a journey in acupuncture. Combined with cupping therapy, there was definitely a noticeable relief from a persistent pain in my left knee following the treatment.

Not only this, I was given some advice on how best to prevent further recurrence of the pain. Of course, prevention being better than cure. However, I also know that I have a strategy to deal with the knee pain if it returns.

I could not have hoped to find a better practitioner in Claire. Incredibly knowledgeable, calm and gentle. More than that though, a thoroughly lovely person with impeccable English. Highly recommended!

First time in Piraluna and definitely come back.

I love the technique and the consultation. Therapist understands what is my problem and fix it correctly.

She was very gentle.

I’ve been receiving treatment at this Traditional Chinese Medicine clinic, and I’m truly impressed. The doctor is highly skilled, kind, and very patient. She completed her degree’s training directly in China, which really gives me confidence in her expertise and treatment approach.
My symptoms have improved significantly, and I no longer feel the pain coming back. I’m very satisfied with the care I received and would definitely recommend this clinic.

The practitioner was highly skilled and took the time to carefully assess my neck and shoulder tension before starting the treatment. The acupuncture process was gentle and much more relaxing than I expected. I felt minimal discomfort, and the practitioner explained each step clearly, which helped me feel at ease.

My partner and I had our first-ever acupuncture and cupping session at Piraluna, and it was an amazing experience. Our practitioner, Claire, spoke fluent English, which made the consultation clear and reassuring.

The whole experience was very relaxing, and Claire was attentive and thoughtful with both of us. If you’ve been considering cupping or acupuncture but haven’t tried it before, I highly recommend Piraluna.

Highly recommend this clinic!  Claire was thorough and caring, and gave me some very helpful tips for my overall health. The tea at the end of the appointment was a really nice touch. I hope to be back!

Piraluna is very excellent service! Very good consult with friendly staff. It helped me a lot with tension in my muscles that were my bad problem, particularly with my neck, shoulder, and whole back. I get the acupuncture with moxa and finish with a cupping. Worked fabulously for me. Thanks so much! (the pic a bit scary, but it not get any pain at all hahaha) ;)

I had a wonderful experience with Claire. She has a deep and well-grounded knowledge of the human body. I came to her with a cold, cough, and shoulder pain, and I felt relief very quickly. After the treatment, I felt so much better overall.
Claire is very kind and warm, which made me feel comfortable right away. I can highly recommend her and will definitely come back again in December!

I took my wife for the cupping therapy to relax after endless hours of meetings.

It's totally her favorite way to chill out now.

Whoa, the clinic even has herbal tea!

I’m so glad I found this clinic! I was suffering from a cough after an illness and was struggling to recover, along with some other long term symptoms. Claire is extremely knowledgeable and made me feel very comfortable during my session as I’ve never had acupuncture before. She gave me some herbal medicine to clear the cough (I am already feeling so much better) and she also went out of her way to order me some more herbs to help with my other symptoms. I am so grateful for her help - I have received more care and information about my body and symptoms than I have from the countless doctors I’ve seen in the UK! Thank you again, wish I was staying longer in Koh Samui so I could come back for another session😌

I was a traveler passing through and was able to be seen the same day. I received personalized care with results the next day! I decided to get acupuncture for digestion issues and received acupuncture in addition to abdominal massage, cupping and moxibustion.

Amazing acupuncture clinic. They just opened but the people working there have been doing it for many years. Everyone was very friendly and caring. Asking all the right questions to be able to help with the issue. Will defenetly be coming back multiple times. Thank you doctor, my knee already feels much better.

Accidentally seen this clinic whilst on holiday. Dr Claire is honestly a walking Wikipedia with a heart. I came in feeling confused, frustrated and very over being medically gaslit (as so many of us women are), and left feeling actually listened to, understood and supported.
I went mainly for period issues and stubborn weight gain, and she didn’t just brush it off — she explained everything so clearly, in a way that finally made sense, and created a treatment plan just for me while I am in Koh Samui. I saw a noticeable improvement with my very next cycle, which felt nothing short of a small miracle.
I also tried acupuncture and cupping for the first time (slightly scared, not going to lie as I don't do well with needles), and I ended up loving both. Surprisingly relaxing, and way more effective than I expected.
If you’re tired of being told “everything looks normal” while you feel anything but — go see Dr Claire. I’m genuinely so grateful I did. 💛

Incredible service, it's a new and very "homey" traditional Chinese medicine clinic with super friendly staff.. I was initially a little worried about needles, but it helped a lot with tension in my muscles, particularly with my lower back, and I'm very grateful. She also did cupping & moxa, which combined, worked fabulously for me. Thanks so much!

I've been feeling kinda crappy right before my period for the past 2-3 years. I've thrown everything at it, supplements, major changes to my routine; but it's barely improved at all.

It's got me all anxious, screwing with my mood and making me snap at everything way too much.

My bestie suggested seeing a therapist here, so I gave it a shot.

She sorted out all my doubts and broke down the whole period thing for women my age super clearly.

Thanks a bunch, doc!

I'll for sure keep coming back for more sessions.

If you’re struggling with a herniated disc, go see Claire from Piraluna Clinic. I’ve seen a huge improvement already half way through my 5-session course. Not only is she skilled, but her attitude is so encouraging and supportive. I’ll definitely be buying more sessions to continue my healing journey.

My partner and I were treated by Claire, lovely and very knowledgeable doctor. My partner had a digestion problem that was resolved within days by a combination of needles, massage, cupping and moxa. I had back pain and muscle tightness. Needles and cupping/massage helped a lot. Claire also gave us very insightful dietary recommendations. We went to see her 3 times in one week that we stayed in Samui, and we’ll definitely go back to the clinic as soon as we return to the island.

Amazing experience! I am new to Chinese Traditional Medicine and I couldn’t be happier with my outcome. My pain significantly decreased after the acupuncture treatment. The clinic is lovely and staff makes you feel right at home. You walk away feeling less pain and like you just made new friends. Highly recommend!

Great service at Piealuna, so worth it and such value. Practitioners are very knowledgeable and have such a good energy to be around. The session was amazing and I left feeling different and can see the improvement in my condition everytime I return, looking forward to going back for some TCM.
Good doctor and professional. Highly recommended.
Amazing experience

I was treated by Claire for several pains.
She is very kind, professional, gentle, and attentive. She really takes the time with her patients and gave me lots of helpful advice.🥰 …
A lovely little TCM clinic in Koh Samui – near Lamai on the ring road. The doctor is very nice and speaks Thai and English, as well as a few words of German. She knows her stuff and does a great job.

The clinic was very clean. Initially, I wanted to come for acupuncture to treat my work-related aches and pains, but I also have asthma. Dr. Kan recommended medication and advised me on diet and self-care. Dr. Kan was very gentle and gave excellent advice. The acupuncture wasn't as painful as I expected. I was very impressed!
The doctor was very kind, had a very gentle touch (it didn't hurt at all), and gave advice on post-treatment health care, which helped the treatment show results faster.

Travel is the ultimate test of one's health, especially as you get older. If your constitution isn't strong enough, any problems that arise will be amplified. A series of discomforts started in Bangkok: a runny nose and sore throat requiring cold medicine; in Chiang Mai, insect bites on both feet caused swelling and redness extending to the ankles; in Phuket, antibiotic ointment was bought, and while the foot wounds began to heal, the cold symptoms escalated into a persistent, phlegmy cough that wouldn't stop, especially at night; and finally, in Koh Samui, this morning, a slight movement while coughing resulted in a strained right shoulder! All of this made me decide to stop taking medicine and seek treatment from a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner!

I found this clinic online with excellent reviews, easily located it, and rang the doorbell. There I met Claire. I filled out an online form and scheduled an appointment. She patiently listened to my explanation and treated me from head to toe with acupuncture and cupping. She also thoughtfully gave me many tips on how to maintain my health. This considerate and personalized treatment made me feel very cared for! It felt like home!

Thank you, Claire, for your kindness and professionalism! The most amazing thing is that after I left the clinic, all the coughing and phlegm were gone! My back also felt much more relaxed! I think I'll feel even better when I wake up tomorrow!

I hope this message can help those in need. You can come to this clinic for care and relief. 😊

The doctor is very gentle and extremely friendly. I had office syndrome and after receiving acupuncture and cupping therapy here, my symptoms have significantly improved, almost completely disappearing. The doctor's technique is truly excellent. I had neck, shoulder, and leg pain from sitting for long periods. After acupuncture and cupping therapy, the leg pain completely vanished, unbelievable! Importantly, the clinic is very clean.

The clinic is lovely and clean.
The doctor is kind and experienced. My pain has greatly improved.

I made an appointment with Dr. Claire for a minor respiratory issue following a bout of Covid. I had the pleasant feeling of being received at a spa rather than a clinic. Finally, a doctor who listens, is understanding, and is incredibly gentle. At the end of our one-on-one session over tea, she gave me lots of helpful tips to ease my symptoms and take care of myself. A huge thank you!

I was in a car accident a few years ago, and I was injured in a car accident. After the acupuncture and cupping doctor, I felt a lot of relief after the second day, although it was painful! He gives a lot of suggestions, and I'm sure they will be helpful!

The therapist was incredibly gentle. Initially, I just wanted cupping therapy, but I saw they offered acupuncture, so I tried that too. It was my first time getting acupuncture, and I'm quite afraid of needles, but it went well and didn't hurt at all. I was very impressed! If you're traveling and experiencing body aches or want to try something new, I highly recommend it!
A superb experience, a practitioner who truly understands traditional medicine. She speaks excellent English and is a very good listener. I highly recommend her :)

The clinic is clean, the doctors are friendly and helpful, and the care is excellent. As a clinic specializing in traditional Chinese medicine, it provides treatment from the root, treating the inside out, leaving a great feeling.
The doctor is very kind and friendly. The clinic is clean. I am impressed with the service.
A fantastic first experience! I would gladly come back. Thank you!
The staff are lovely and the doctor is very skilled.
